name: 棱台体积(辛普森)计算器

map.由两端与中截面面积求棱台体积: Frustum Volume from End and Mid-Section Areas
map.输入两端面积 A₁、A₂、中截面 A_m 与间距 L，求体积。: Enter the two end areas A₁, A₂, mid section A_m and spacing L to obtain the volume.
map.📖 查看「由两端与中截面面积求棱台体积 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Frustum Volume from End and Mid-Section Areas User Guide"
map.辛普森法，比平均断面更精确。: Simpson's rule, more accurate than average end-area.
map.由两端与中截面面积按棱镜体公式算方量。: Compute volume from end and mid-section areas by the prismoidal formula.
map.线性变化时与平均断面同；非线性（如锥形）棱镜体更准，避免平均法误差。: Equal to average end-area under linear change; for nonlinear (e.g. conical) the prismoidal is more accurate, avoiding average-method error.
map.V=L/6(A₁+4Am+A₂)，Am 为距中点处截面，辛普森积分近似。: V = L/6(A₁+4Am+A₂), Am is the section at the midpoint, a Simpson-integration approximation.
map.断面变化非线性（边坡陡变、堆体）时，平均法系统性偏差，用棱镜体。: When section change is nonlinear (steep slope breaks, heaps), the average method has systematic bias; use prismoidal.

map.棱柱体法体积（本页代码口径）：V=长度 L÷6×(端面积 A₁+4×中间断面面积: Prismoidal volume (page code convention): V=length L÷6×(end area A₁+4×middle section area Am+end area A₂) (m³); linked values: average end-area comparison=L×(A₁+A₂)÷2, section difference=Am−(A₁+A₂)÷2. Validation: no strict validation; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; when Am exceeds the average of the two ends, the prismoidal result is larger than the average end-area method; the main result keeps 2 decimals.
